project.name: affweb
project.purpose: Vietnam affiliate cashback web app/PWA with independent order validation and settlement authority, platform-wallet cashback, and externally settled tenant channels.
project.identity: Clerk with local authorization and WebAuthn finance step-up
project.deployment: Vercel deployment target; the repository currently contains no GitHub Actions workflow after commit 28c2342

layers.responsibility: Next App Router pages, route handlers, metadata, PWA, and server actions.
Application UI and reusable Radix/Tailwind primitives.
Cross-cutting environment, identity, database, security, money, logging, and request helpers.
Business domains: connectors, clicks, conversions, ledger, payout, identity, notifications, evidence, and jobs.
Source-of-truth data model, migrations, database invariants, and idempotent seed data.
Database integration and browser-level E2E verification.
BRD/TDD, market/API evidence, threat model, and production operations.

criticalFlows.affiliateClick: POST /api/v1/links -> explicit/default provider account and campaign policy -> provider tracking link with immutable attribution snapshot -> /go/[clickToken].
criticalFlows.conversion: Provider API or Shopee Orders CSV -> lossless canonical conversion -> configured validation hold -> validated without wallet release -> exact-match reconciliation/Finance settlement -> journal and wallet.
criticalFlows.payout: Beneficiary encryption + 72h hold -> reserve wallet -> independent review -> distinct approval -> payOS submit -> reconciliation -> paid or released journal.
criticalFlows.identity: Clerk middleware/session -> local reconciliation/invitation -> role enforcement -> fresh verified Google admin session -> passkey for finance actions.
criticalFlows.notification: Domain OutboxEvent -> materialize notification -> email/push deliveries -> browser service worker notification.
criticalFlows.tenant: Business tenant credential/Zalo route -> TENANT_MEMBER or TENANT_CHANNEL link -> tenant conversion/evidence only -> owner audited external payment; no platform ledger/wallet.

nonNegotiableInvariants: PostgreSQL is the financial source of truth; WalletProjection is a projection, not a substitute ledger.
Every journal has positive entries and equal debit/credit totals.
LedgerTransaction and LedgerEntry are append-only at the database trigger level.
Money uses bigint VND and basis points; never JavaScript floating point for persisted money.
Higher-authority evidence may revise weaker evidence; corrections post compensating journals.
Payout is fail-closed behind both environment credentials and the database payout.enabled flag.
Creator, reviewer, and approver separation plus a recent passkey protect finance actions.
Secrets, bank plaintext, cookies, and tokens never enter logs, client bundles, or project_map.json.
Private/API/auth/app/admin/go routes are network-only in the service worker.
Tenant owner is a platform member; owning a tenant is resource ownership, not a replacement for staff/finance roles.
Tenant cashback subtracts 10% estimated tax before applying the snapshotted member share.
Tenant conversions never post platform ledger/wallet/payout; external payment confirmation is owner-scoped and audited.
Order validation and settlement are independent; validation hold expiry never releases available wallet.
Raw and settlement evidence is hashed and append-only; production objects use S3 Object Lock.
Shopee settlement requires a closed reconciliation invoice, exact line mapping, account identity, and total tie-out.

externalServices.Neon: Remote PostgreSQL; pooled DATABASE_URL for runtime and DIRECT_URL/unpooled URL for migrations.
externalServices.Clerk: Authentication, Google/email flows, invitations, sessions, user lifecycle webhooks.
externalServices.UpstashRedis: Rate limits and short-lived admin-session verification cache.
externalServices.Shopee: Direct links, Orders acquisition from versioned conversion-report CSV, and reconciliation authority only from a closed line-level invoice detail export.
externalServices.AddLiveTag: No private production dependency; equivalent authenticated link inspection and tax tools are implemented internally.
externalServices.AccessTrade: Official publisher link/transaction/order/product/detail APIs; validation authority only, settlement remains Finance-controlled.
externalServices.Lazada: Official /marketing/getlink and /marketing/conversion/report operations; validation authority only, settlement remains Finance-controlled.
externalServices.payOS: Payout processing plus tenant SaaS subscription checkout and signed renewal webhook.
externalServices.AWS: OIDC-assumed role and S3 Object Lock for immutable production evidence.
externalServices.Sentry: Server/client error capture with PII stripping.
externalServices.Zalo: Central Zalo Bot group binding and shopping-link automation prototype for tenant channels.

commands.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build

environment.safety: Full integration tests automatically use DATABASE_URL; run them only against a disposable isolated database.

migrationSafeguards: Migrations are expand/backfill/contract and are never applied with prisma db push in staging/production.
Runtime uses pooled DATABASE_URL; migration uses DIRECT_URL or DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED.
Ledger and settlement evidence are protected by append-only database triggers.
Integration tests require a disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL distinct from every runtime/migration URL.
